business_problem: Arcadis wanted to drive greater efficiency with self-service automation tailored to each project and client. At the same time, the company wanted to avoid the high costs of development with custom code.
solution_summary: Arcadis wanted to drive greater efficiency with self-service automation tailored to each project and client. At the same time, the company wanted to avoid the high costs of development with custom code. With the adoption of Power Platform, Arcadis now supports an active Power Platform community of over 3,000 members. Solutions range from automated extraction of data in SharePoint and Oracle to classification of documents using natural language processing. The company recently migrated over 50 automation projects from a third-party platform to Power Automate and has moved from SharePoint to Dataverse for better scalability and security. Arcadis is also working with new Power Platform innovations such as Plan Designer and plans to triple its premium Power Platform licenses in 2025.
